stemMd: The meeting seemed harmonious until the minutes revealed that participants had attached incompatible meanings to the key term; the apparent consensus was ______.
explanationMd: The agreement existed at the level of words but not shared meaning. Illusory captures why the initial appearance of consensus fails under closer examination.

distractorRationale.b: The disagreement was hidden rather than explicit in the apparent agreement.
distractorRationale.e: The participants did not share the same substantive meaning.
distractorRationale.c: No legal or procedural force is stated.
